name: Multipolar World — 2010 (original sectors)
description: Dated geographic atlas sandbox (2010-01-01). Capitals use geographic coordinates; operational sectors are generated, not historical provinces. Colonial control follows an explicit scenario overlay.
worldContext: The world is emerging from the global financial crisis. Model a multipolar international system at the beginning of 2010, without knowledge of later events determining outcomes.
simulationRules: Use the selected date and nation catalog. Some map entities are dependent administrations, not independent sovereign countries. Do not treat every territory as independent. Recruitment starts only through approved actions. Resources are game-balance defaults.
